name: India–Pakistan
summary: India–Pakistan airspace bans remain; no military strikes since 2025
state: India and Pakistan keep reciprocal bans on each other's aircraft, with Pakistan's current ban running to 24 Nov, and relations remain frozen since the May 2025 crisis (CFR Global Conflict Tracker). Searches on 5 Nov found no new cross-border strike, mobilisation or Line of Control clash.
for_you: Flights between India, Pakistan and onward routes may take longer because of airspace bans. Travellers should check FCDO advice for border areas.
rubric_hit: Treaty suspensions and airspace bans in place; no strikes or mobilisation = Watch

sources.title: CFR — Global Conflict Tracker: conflict between India and Pakistan

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
drivers: Kashmir attacks, Line of Control firing, water disputes (Indus), domestic politics.

rubric.watch: Ceasefire violations, a major terrorist attack with blame assigned, or treaty suspensions.
rubric.normal: Ceasefire holding along the Line of Control; no major attacks.
